name: Jamie Turner
biography: Senior Investigative Computer Specialist Jamie Turner is a Senior Investigative Computer Specialist for the Naval Criminal Investigative Service. He has over 20 years of professional experience in the cyber field with the last 10 years conducting computer crime investigations and operations. Jamie holds several IT and forensics certifications and is considered an one of the best experts for NCIS Cyber in the fields of computer forensics, mobile forensics, data recovery and court room testimony.
